grok-4.7.quote: Steady-state cool diffusion flames on spherical porous burners.

grok-4.7.statement: The record describes cool diffusion flames as having peak temperatures of 500–1000 K.
grok-4.7.quote: Research into cool diffusion flames (whose peak temperatures are 500 – 1000 K) has grown exponentially since they were discovered in 2012.

grok-4.7.statement: A stated hypothesis is that decreasing the fluent flow rate extinguishes the cool flame, while increasing it can transition the flame to a hot diffusion flame, with possible oscillation.
grok-4.7.quote: Cool diffusion flames for which a decrease in fluent flow rate will cause extinction, whereas an increase will cause a transition to a hot diffusion flame, with oscillation possible between hot and cool flames.

grok-4.7.statement: Flames are to be observed with cameras, radiometers, photomultiplier tubes, and thermocouples.
grok-4.7.quote: Observe the flames with a broad suite of cameras, radiometers, photomultiplier tubes, and thermocouples.
